dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Before you guys arrived, I did some more artwork for Nepecha. It's boxed up and sitting on my desk, ready to go.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Could you wait for me here, Xilonen? I'll run home and grab it. I'll try not to be too long.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Are you kidding me? I'm not waiting here. I'll come with you!

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Oh, even better! Then you can come in for a snack!
